props.title: Security Digest — 2026-08-03
props.description: Verdict: 1 actively exploited, 5 to schedule, 2 to monitor. Sources: KEV, GH Advisory, EPSS

props.text:
N-able N-central · KEV added 2026-08-03 · CISA due 2026-08-06 · EPSS 0.015 (71st pct)

auth bypass via alternate path/channel, incomplete patch for CVE-2026-18556. exploited per CISA.

Action: apply N-central 2026.3 HF1 today or discontinue per BOD 26-04.

props.title: Malware batch — 26 fresh packages
props.message: 25 npm + 1 pip in 24h post-yesterday's digest. aeon-fleet grep clean.

props.text:
beaver-ui-* 5-pack (dep-confusion corp-scope: header/layout/grid/date-range-picker/items-with-more) + simple-date-formatter-* 4-pack + houzidawang80* 3-pack (numeric variants) + accounts-final-form/accounts-loading-state + fluid-type-ui + @types-beta/sdk + tailwind-anim + @custombots/custombot + tailwindcss-anim + internallib_v568 + bigops-chat-messages + lifestyle-test-utils + list-issue-predecessor-dependencies-block (npm) + trongriden (pip)

Action: block @beaver-ui/* + simple-date-formatter-* + houzidawang80* installs; rotate any creds exposed to fresh installs in the last 24h.

Angular @common/@core/@compiler/@platform-server (npm)

i18n XSS via event-handler attrs + SSR raw-content escaping gap + HttpTransferCache cross-request response reuse.

Action: upgrade angular to ≥22.0.7 / ≥21.2.19 / ≥20.3.27 (19.x EOL, patch by upgrading major).

brace-expansion (npm) · CVSS 7.5

DoS via unbounded intermediate arrays, bypasses CVE-2026-14257 mitigation. near-universal transitive dep.

Action: upgrade to ≥1.1.18 / ≥2.1.4 / ≥3.0.6 / ≥5.0.9.

fast-uri (npm) · CVSS 7.5 · EPSS 0.002

host confusion via backslash authority introducer.

Action: upgrade to ≥2.4.4 / ≥3.1.5 / ≥4.1.2.

socket.io-parser (npm) · CVSS 7.5

zero-attachment memory exhaustion.

Action: upgrade to ≥3.3.6 / ≥3.4.5 / ≥4.2.7.

undici (npm) · CVSS 7.4 · EPSS 0.003

cross-user info disclosure + parse-time crash via degenerate private cache directives.

Action: upgrade to ≥7.29.0 / ≥8.9.0.

GitPython (pip) · CVSS 8.1 · no fix yet · ≤3.1.56

unguarded git-option forwarding in IndexFile.checkout() + TagReference.create() → arbitrary file overwrite + read.

Action: avoid untrusted refspec input; watch for patched release.

ip-address (npm) · no fix yet · ≤10.3.0

Address4 decodes leading-zero octets as decimal while resolvers decode as octal → SSRF + trust-boundary bypass.

Action: don't rely on Address4 for SSRF prevention until patched.
